desc:
🧪 **Would You Rather: SCP Morph Tower!**

Climb the tower, make your choice, and become an SCP! 👁️

At every stage, you’ll face **two different doors**. Pick the SCP you’d rather become, walk through the door, and **MORPH into your choice!**

🏢 Climb through the SCP Tower  
🚪 Choose between two SCPs  
👹 Transform into creepy & powerful morphs  
🏆 Reach the top of the tower  
🎁 Unlock rewards as you play  
👥 Compare your choices with other players  
🔄 Replay and choose different SCPs!

Can you survive every stage and make it all the way to the top?

⭐ **LIKE & FAVORITE** for more SCPs, stages, morphs, and updates!

**Would You Rather... choose wisely.**
